page.overview:
Who is D'Garratt?

D'Garratt is a roadwarden of the Empire and his nemesis is the Highwayman Vincent Quaine.

One night on patrol, Roadwarden D'Garratt stumbled across a stagecoach from Marienburg being robbed by a gang from Middenheim known as the "Cold Hammers". He recognised one of the robbers as the notorious highwayman Vincent Quaine, who had been hired by the Cold Hammers and had escaped D'Garratt before.

D'Garratt immediately began to fire on them with his crossbow. Any gang member that tried to attack him in melee as he was reloading were struck by his horseman's hammer.

While D'Garratt was busy fighting the Cold Hammers, Quaine took advantage of the confusion and began to loot the coach of treasure and placed the bags of loot on the saddle of his horse and galloped away. After D'Garratt finished killing the gang members he immediately pursued Quaine on his steed.
